_schema.coords: model-local glTF coordinates (Y up, +X forward, +Z = Blender -Y); same frame as the rock root node
_schema.veins[i].node: name of the child mesh node (Vein_<i>)
_schema.veins[i].points: centreline of the ore fill at ridge height (the faceted ridge vertices wander up to +-0.25 halfWidth sideways), ordered along u; point k has u = cumulative chord length / length
_schema.veins[i].u: u of each point (= TEXCOORD_1.u of the matching fill row)
_schema.veins[i].length: polyline arc length in units (sum of chord lengths)
_schema.veins[i].halfWidth: fill half width per point (groove opening is wider)
_schema.veins[i].type: vein mechanic (spec 2.1.1): drift = Fe/Cu moving segment, deep = Ti, singing = Kr (tone peak bonus), fast = VZ (short, fast segment)
_schema.uv1: TEXCOORD_1 of Vein_<i>: u = normalised arc length 0..1 (matches points), v = 0..1 across the fill
